answer_1.quote: we focus on downstream generation tasks with low-resource Indic languages... we evaluate its performance across four distinct text generation tasks on a subset of languages outlined in : Cross-Lingual Question Answering (XorQA-In), Multilingual Question-Answering (XQuAD-In), Machine Translation (Flores-In), and Cross-Lingual Summarization (CrossSum-In)
answer_1.outputs: Answers for question answering, translations for machine translation, summaries for cross-lingual summarization

answer_2.quote: we report the Character-F1 (chrF1) metric for cross-lingual summarization and translation tasks... For QA tasks (XQuAD-IN and XorQA-IN), we use the Token-F1 metric
